findings.what: Tests/app depend on node:sqlite and native TS type-stripping but no engines field declares the Node version; tests also emit MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON warning
DB insert failures are not caught; the server action throws, the user sees a generic error and loses form input
Length limits use UTF-16 .length (astral chars count double) on trimmed values rather than true character count
Email regex is permissive (accepts e.g. a@b..c)
No rate limiting or spam protection on a public form that writes to the DB (not required by PRD)
